title: Green Wave Washes over Mainstream Shopping

sentences.en: Research in Britain has shown that ‘green consumers’ continue to flourish as a significant group amongst shoppers.
sentences.zh: 英国的研究表明, " 绿色消费者 " 作为顾客中的一个重要群体,继续蓬勃发展。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: This suggests that politicians who claim environmentalism is yesterday’s issue may be seriously misjudging the public mood.
sentences.zh: 这表明那些声称环保主义是昨天议题的政客可能严重误解公众情绪。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词。

sentences.en: A report from Mintel, the market research organisation, says that despite recession and financial pressures, more people than ever want to buy environmentally friendly products and a ‘green wave’ has swept through consumerism, taking in people previously untouched by environmental concerns.
sentences.zh: 市场研究组织Mintel的一份报告指出, 尽管经济衰退和金融压力, 更多人比以往更想购买环保产品,

grammar.type: 分词结构 + 不定式结构

sentences.en: The recently published report also predicts that the process will repeat itself with ‘ethical’ concerns, involving issues such as fair trade with the Third World and the social record of businesses.
sentences.zh: 最近发表的报告还预测,这一进程将重复 " 道德 " 关切,涉及与第三世界的公平贸易和企业的社会记录等问题。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；分词短语压缩了背景或附加动作。

sentences.en: Companies will have to be more honest and open in response to this mood.
sentences.zh: 公司必须更加诚实和开放,以回应这种情绪。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Mintel’s survey, based on nearly 1,000 consumers, found that the proportion who look for green products and are prepared to pay more for them has climbed from 53 per cent in 1990 to around 60 per cent in 1994.
sentences.zh: 以近1 000名消费者为基础的Mintel调查发现,寻找绿色产品并愿意支付更多产品的占比已从1990年的53%上升到1994年的60%左右。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 被动语态
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: On average, they will pay 13 per cent more for such products, although this percentage is higher among women, managerial and professional groups and those aged 35 to 44.
sentences.zh: 平均而言,她们将支付13%以上的此类产品,尽管这个百分比在妇女、管理和专业群体以及35至44岁年龄段的妇女、管理和专业群体中较高。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系。

sentences.en: Between 1990 and 1994 the proportion of consumers claiming to be unaware of or unconcerned about green issues fell from 18 to 10 per cent but the number of green spenders among older people and manual workers has risen substantially.
sentences.zh: 1990年至1994年期间,声称不知道或不关心绿色问题的消费者比例从18%降至10%,但老年人和体力劳动者中的绿色支出人数大幅增加。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Regions such as Scotland have also caught up with the south of England in their environmental concerns.
sentences.zh: 苏格兰等地区也在环境关切方面与英格兰南部接轨。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: According to Mintel, the image of green consumerism as associated in the past with the more eccentric members of society has virtually disappeared.
sentences.zh: Mintel认为,过去与社会上较为偏心的成员相关的绿色消费主义形象实际上已经消失。

grammar.type: 分词结构 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；分词短语压缩了背景或附加动作；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: The consumer research manager for Mintel, Angela Hughes, said it had become firmly established as a mainstream market.
sentences.zh: Mintel的消费者研究经理Angela Hughes说,它已经牢固地确立为主流市场。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: She explained that as far as the average person is concerned environmentalism has not ‘gone off the boil’.
sentences.zh: 她解释说,就普通人而言,环境主义并没有“消失”。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: In fact, it has spread across a much wider range of consumer groups, ages and occupations.
sentences.zh: 事实上,它已经扩展到更广泛的消费群体、年龄和职业。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Mintel’s 1994 survey found that 13 per cent of consumers are ‘very dark green’, nearly always buying environmentally friendly products, 28 per cent are ‘dark green’, trying ‘as far as possible’ to buy such products, and 21 per cent are ‘pale green’ – tending to buy green products if they see them.
sentences.zh: 明特尔1994年的调查发现,13%的消费者是`非常黑暗的绿色 ',几乎总是购买环保产品,28%是`黑暗的绿色 ',试图`尽可能 ' 购买此类产品,21%是`大绿 ',如果看到绿色产品,则倾向于购买。

grammar.type: 状语从句 + 分词结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系；分词短语压缩了背景或附加动作。

sentences.en: Another 26 per cent are ‘armchair greens’; they said they care about environmental issues but their concern does not affect their spending habits.
sentences.zh: 另26%是“武器椅绿地”, 他们说他们关心环境问题,

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Only 10 per cent say they do not care about green issues.
sentences.zh: 只有10%的人说他们不在乎绿色问题。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Four in ten people are ‘ethical spenders’, buying goods which do not, for example, involve dealings with oppressive regimes.
sentences.zh: 购买商品, 例如不涉及与压迫政权打交道。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 分词结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；分词短语压缩了背景或附加动作。

sentences.en: This figure is the same its in 1990, although the number of ‘armchair ethicals’ has risen from 28 to 35 per cent and only 22 per cent say they are unconcerned now, against 30 per cent in 1990.
sentences.zh: 1990年这一数字与1990年相同,尽管 " 军职主席道德 " 的人数从28%增加到35%,只有22%的人表示现在不关心,而1990年是30%。

grammar.type: 被动语态 + 状语从句
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系。

sentences.en: Hughes claims that in the twenty-first century, consumers will be encouraged to think more about the entire history of the products and services they buy, including the policies of the companies that provide them and that this will require a greater degree of honesty with consumers.
sentences.zh: Hughes声称,在二十一世纪,将鼓励消费者更多地思考他们购买的产品和服务的整个历史,包括提供产品和服务的公司的政策,这需要更诚实地对待消费者。

grammar.type: 被动语态 + 分词结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者；分词短语压缩了背景或附加动作。

sentences.en: Among green consumers, animal testing is the top issue – 48 per cent said they would be deterred from buying a product it if had been tested on animals – followed by concerns regarding irresponsible selling, the ozone layer, river and sea pollution, forest destruction, recycling and factory farming.
sentences.zh: 在绿色消费者中,动物试验是首要问题 — — 48%的人说,如果对动物进行试验,动物试验将无法购买产品,接下来是不负责任的销售、臭氧层、河流和海洋污染、森林破坏、回收利用和工厂耕作等问题。

grammar.type: 被动语态 + 状语从句
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系。

sentences.en: However, concern for specific issues is lower than in 1990, suggesting that many consumers feel that Government and business have taken on the environmental agenda.
sentences.zh: 然而,对具体问题的关注程度低于1990年,这表明许多消费者认为政府和企业已经将环境议程列入环境议程。

Mintel have limited their investigation to professional and managerial groups.
